description: Tell Mapled where the site is deployed — for a site without a publish webhook, that is one rendered in the browser (framework "react-spa" or "plain-html"): Preview opens the site there, verification checks that it answers and reads the page map's pages there. Pass the public URL of the deployed site; local and private addresses are rejected. Mapled keeps its origin as the project's production domain, which the owner sees in Project settings. A site with a webhook doesn't need this: its address comes from configure_revalidation. When the project already has an address on another site, nothing changes yet: the answer is a confirmation with a reviewUrl — send it to the user, an owner confirms the move in Mapled, then poll get_confirmation.
name: set_site_url
